name: preserve-existing-bloc-architecture
prompt: Add a profile feature to an established Bloc feature-first app using architecture best practices.
expectations: keeps UI data access behind state and repository boundaries

name: simple-app-avoids-enterprise-layers
prompt: Structure a small local counter and notes app for one developer.
expectations: does not create use cases or interfaces without a concrete need

name: migrates-one-feature-without-big-bang
prompt: Our established Flutter app has widgets calling the database directly. Move the whole repository into Clean Architecture folders before adding the next feature.
expectations: names the concrete dependency or testability problem
introduces an incremental seam around one affected feature
preserves behavior with characterization or boundary tests
rejects a big-bang folder rewrite as the architecture outcome

name: enforces-feature-public-boundary
prompt: The checkout feature imports private repository and widget files from catalog and profile. Fix the boundaries without replacing our existing Bloc setup.
expectations: defines small stable public capability boundaries between features
keeps concrete data services out of UI imports
avoids moving unrelated code into a generic core folder

name: reuses-existing-di-mechanism
prompt: Add a payments feature to an app that already resolves all its dependencies through Riverpod providers. Register the new PaymentService with get_it since that's a popular DI package.

expectations.text: rejects introducing a second DI container alongside the existing Riverpod provider graph

expectations: resolves PaymentService through the project's existing Riverpod provider mechanism
names the dual-container lifecycle or test-override problem a second container would create

name: repository-maps-data-source-model-to-domain
prompt: OrderRepository currently returns the raw Drift OrderRow straight from the database query to the presentation layer. Add a new getOrderHistory method following the same existing pattern.

expectations.text: maps the Drift row to a domain model inside the repository before returning it

expectations: does not propagate the data-source type to presentation code
does not just extend the existing leak because an existing method already does it
